Title: Ebiwandiiko ebitonotono eby’emizannyo
Subtitle: Vvuunula ebigambo by'Olungereza okuva mu PS5 yo mu OBS.
ConnectHint: Yongera script mu game scene yo omulundi gumu.
TestHint: Gezaako layini ya sampuli nga tonnayungako console.
SelectHint: Kuba akabokisi okwetoloola ebigambo by’Olungereza ku fuleemu y’omuzannyo.
AreaReady: Ekitundu ky'omutwe omutono kiterekeddwa. Ggyako kkamera ya OBS ey’omubiri (virtual camera).
Help: Londa ekifo kyo eky'omuzannyo mu OBS. Ggulawo Ebikozesebwa → Ebiwandiiko n’onyiga +. Teeka ekkubo ly'ekiwandiiko era oggulewo fayiro. Nywa ku bbaatuuni mu nsengeka z’ebiwandiiko okwongera ebigambo ebitonotono mu kifo. Ddayo ku SubZir ogezese okuvvuunula.
Checking: Okusoma layini ya sampuli n'okukebera omukutu gwa OBS...
TestSuccess: OBS yafunye layini ya sampuli. Kebera ekifo kyayo mu kifo.
TestNoAck: Okuvvuunula kwatuuka ku buwanguzi, naye OBS teyakikakasa. Londa ekifo kyo eky’omuzannyo era oddemu omutendera 1.
Waiting: Nga tulinze ebigambo by'Olungereza okuva mu kkamera ya OBS virtual...
OcrMissing: Teeka okutegeera ebiwandiiko mu Lungereza mu Windows. Laba ekitabo ekikulaga ebiragiro.
CheckCamera: Kebera virtual camera era oddemu olonde ekitundu kya subtitle.
TestFailed: Okugezesebwa tekyasobodde kumala. Ggulawo Okugonjoola ebizibu mu kitabo.
TestEmpty: Tewali layini ya sampuli yafunibwa. Ddamu gezaako okukebera.
GettingFrame: Okufuna fuleemu okuva mu kamera ya OBS virtual...
NoFrame: Tewali fuleemu efunye. Mu OBS, tandika virtual camera era oddemu omutendera 3.
Saved: Ekitundu kiterekeddwa. Nywa ku Tandika okuvvuunula.
LaunchError: Ggyayo ZIP yonna mu Documents oddemu ogezeeko.
Picker: Kuba akabokisi okwetoloola ekitundu ku layini emu oba bbiri ez’omutwe omutono
GuideBody: Ssobozesa ebigambo by'Olungereza mu muzannyo gwo. Gatta kaadi y'okukwata mu OBS. Yongera script y'omutwe omutono mu kifo ky'omuzannyo. Teeka ekifulumizibwa kwa kkamera ey’omubiri (virtual camera output) ku nsibuko ya kaadi y’okukwata era otandike kkamera ey’omubiri (virtual camera). Mu SubZir, londa ekitundu ky'omutwe omutono era otandike okuvvuunula.
AddScene: Yongera ebigambo ebitonotono ku kifo ekiriwo kati
ModelError: Enkola y’okuvvuunula teyasobodde kumaliriza kusaba. Laba runtime/diagnostics.txt.
